Tribute.title: Tribute
Tribute.description: Tracks total unique flower offerings left by visitors at a character's tombstone.

characterId.description: The unique identifier of the character tombstone.

flowerCount.description: Total number of unique visitors who offered a white chrysanthemum.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the most recent flower offering.

TributeVisitor.title: TributeVisitor
TributeVisitor.description: Records a single unique visitor's flower offering for a specific character tombstone to prevent duplicate likes and persist unlock status.

characterId.description: The unique identifier of the character tombstone.

visitorId.description: Deterministic anonymous fingerprint ID (IP + device hash) of the visitor.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the visitor offered the flower.

/tributes/{characterId}.description: Stores permanent unique flower offering counts per character tombstone.

/tributes/{characterId}/visitors/{visito.description: Stores one document per unique visitor per character tombstone so each visitor can only offer one flower and permanently unlocks the epitaph.
